en: Black‑and‑white photograph with scalloped edges showing a small rural village nestled among rolling fields and wooded hills. In the center stands a church with a square tower and tall pointed spire, surrounded by modest houses with pitched roofs and gardens. Patchwork farmland and distant low hills fill the background under a sky with scattered clouds. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
